content:
nina: Deploybot blocked prod promote for tag v2026.02.9. Reason: attestation missing in target GCR account for amd64 digest. anyone oncall?

deploybot: publish-check FAIL: attestation-check: not found for gcr.io/redwood/prod:v2026.02.9@sha256:aa11bb22

chris: we've mirrored the image but the cosign payload didn't get copied across during account sync. mirror logs show 403 on upload of attestation blob.

ops-bot: NOTE: last sync job used creds from mirror-role-archived; rotation flagged 3h ago. runbook: https://go/runbooks/mirror-cred-rotation

mike: product wants release in this window (ends in 25m). options: (1) fix creds and re-run mirror (preferred, ~10-20m) (2) manually cosign in target account and re-run deploybot approve (audit note) (3) bypass (not allowed).

pm: prefer option 1 if safe. do we have quick rollback plan if manual sign is needed?

chris: quick commands if manual path chosen:
```
# in target-account session
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/infra/keys/release-signer gcr.io/redwood/prod@sha256:aa11bb22
# then re-run deploybot
deploybot approve --image gcr.io/redwood/prod:v2026.02.9 --env prod --meta manual-attest:yes
```

nina: infra is fixing role -> pushed PR to add attest-write permission to mirror role. ETA ~12m. I'll monitor mirror job and update.

deploybot: watch: publish-check waiting for attestation.

ops-bot: creds refreshed and mirror requeued (job id 2026-03-21-0952).

deploybot: publish-check PASS; attestation found cosign://gcr/prod@sha256:aa11bb22. Promotion allowed.

pm: release notes: "Brief delay during publish due to attestation copy failure; resolved by mirror role fix. Manual attestation avoided." approved.

mike: post-action: add CI check that validates attest-copy step and an infra lint for role perms. ticket filed: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/1201
